description: This Java class, SecretKeyWrapper, handles the wrapping and unwrapping of SecretKey instances using asymmetric RSA keys stored in Android's KeyStore. It manages key pair generation, key retrieval, and provides methods to securely encrypt (wrap) and decrypt (unwrap) secret keys, enabling secure key management within Android applications.

classes.name: SecretKeyWrapper
classes.description: A utility class for securely wrapping and unwrapping SecretKey objects using RSA key pairs stored securely in Android's KeyStore.

methods.name: SecretKeyWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper, loads or generates the RSA key pair stored under the given alias.

methods.name: generateKeyPair
methods.description: Static method that creates a new RSA key pair in the AndroidKeyStore with specified subject details and validity period.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Encrypts (wraps) a SecretKey using the public RSA key, producing a byte array that can be stored securely.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Decrypts (unwraps) a previously wrapped SecretKey using the private RSA key.
